verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents connecting Outlook, Thunderbird, Apple Mail, or any IMAP/SMTP-compatible client to an inbox. That covers the core open-protocol access and keeps mail reachable outside the API. The evidence is a single doc line, with no JMAP and no standards-based export format (e.g., mbox or EML bulk export) described. Missing for 10: JMAP support, documented standards-based export/migration path, depth on IMAP/SMTP capabilities, independent or hands-on corroboration.
